adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff removes a member via `group.users.delete(user_id)` instead of using the model-level API previously used elsewhere in this diff (`update_patch` deleted code called `group.remove(user)`, and `add_members` still calls `group.add(user)`). This creates an asymmetry where any logic encapsulated in `Group#remove` (callbacks/side effects/validation) would be bypassed for admin removals while additions still go through `Group#add`. However, the finding’s specific claim that this "loads the group's entire membership association" is not directly verifiable from the diff (ActiveRecord association `delete` may issue a direct DELETE without materializing all users).
